'''John Patchell''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] on 5 October 2000 with Throne Room mains, according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1312">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-worlds-clints-penis-game-4-trs-in-1d1312/ worlds-clints-penis-game-4-trs-in-1], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 9 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-worlds-clints-penis-game-4-trs-in-1d1312/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
